_status: The citizenship (N-400) questions the client answers in the portal, added to the reused sections of schemas/question_bank.json (about you, addresses, work, marriage, children, description) -- src/portal/bank.py load_bank('n400'). Each answer fills the same n400.* fact the review app's Citizenship panel shows. Part 9 is asked as checklists: 'none of these' answers No for every item in it; a ticked item stays blank and the attorney sees what was ticked; 'not sure' leaves them blank for the attorney. DRAFT: every wording needs a certified translator and attorney approval before clients see it. The Haitian Creole (ht) is a MACHINE DRAFT awaiting the firm's certified translator.
